title: Invest in Our Youth
body: Expand access to sports, mentorship, and life skills programs that shape confident, capable leaders.

title: Strengthen Education & Opportunity
body: Create pathways for young people to succeed—whether in college, trades, or entrepreneurship.

title: Grow Our Local Economy
body: Support small businesses and create sustainable opportunities that keep money in our community.

title: Safer, Stronger Communities
body: Address root causes—not just symptoms—by investing in prevention, mentorship, and community support.
